title: reingest rollback is a compensating restore, not a transaction: a process kill between the first delete and the end of ingest leaves the session deleted until the snapshot file is replayed by hand
evidence: The in-memory snapshot drives the automatic restore; data/reingest-snapshots/<driveFileId>-<ts>.json is written first but is plain JSON (Dates/ObjectIds become strings) and no code replays it. A kill -9 / power loss mid-run leaves rows deleted and a snapshot on disk.
fix_direction: Either a replay script using EJSON, or a Mongo transaction (needs replica set; not available on the local work database), or write-new-then-swap which needs sources._id to stop colliding (gdrive-<fileId> is shared by old and new session; schema/ change = Approver).

title: after pruning the old session node, topic nodes in UNTOUCHED years keep the old session id in evidence.sessionRefs
evidence: regenerate.ts header discloses this residual gap for untouched years; pruneTreeOfSession relies on regenerate.
fix_direction: full buildTree for the tenant when a reingest prunes a session (cost vs benefit), or accept.

title: ISS-309 cites qa/watch/reingest-2026-09-24-in-focus.log which is not in the repo; its 'tree_index: 1 before and after' is the single per-tenant root document, so the count alone is not an orphan signal
evidence: ls qa/watch -> only 2026-09-25.md. The real orphan is the old session NODE inside the root (year/month/session), which survives when the old session sat in a different year than the new one (regenerate only rebuilds years it can see).
fix_direction: none needed; fixed by pruning the node. Noted so the checker measures node presence, not count.

title: pre-delete snapshot (full transcript turns, claims, 3072-dim vectors) is written as plain JSON to <repo>/data/reingest-snapshots/, which is NOT gitignored, and is deleted only on full success: after a failure whose restore succeeded, or a tree-prune failure, the file stays
evidence: git check-ignore data/reingest-snapshots/x.json -> no rule (checker run 2026-10-11); .gitignore lists only data/bot-profile, data/browser, data/qa-checker-*, data/toc-migrated/synthetic-*. finish() runs only after replaceSessionRows returns; the failure branch throws without removing snapshotRef even when e.restored is true. Default file mode, no EJSON, no per-tenant directory (name is <driveFileId>-<Date.now()>).
fix_direction: gitignore data/reingest-snapshots/; remove the snapshot when e.restored === true; write under a per-tenant dir with restrictive mode; use EJSON so the file is replayable (also closes ISS-REINGESTSAFE-001's type loss).

title: no guard against two concurrent reingests of the same Drive file: the second snapshots after the first has deleted (empty/partial snapshot) and its restore can erase the first run's new rows; the tree_index prune is a read-modify-write of the root with no revision check
evidence: read of replaceSessionRows: no lock, no expected-revision; restore removes every session linked to gdrive-<driveFileId> other than the pre-existing id.
fix_direction: single-run lock per driveFileId in the caller.
